headline: Elon Musk mocked SoftBank's reported plan to raise up to $100 billion for an AI fund, writing that "only a fool would give them money".
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: the reported $100 billion plan is large, though Musk's remark is a jibe from a rival and the plan is unconfirmed talks.
importance_line: Investors and lenders weighing SoftBank's AI bets are affected first, but the fund is only reported talks and Musk, who is suing OpenAI, is not a neutral voice.
summary: Stocktwits reports, in a story Yahoo Finance carries, that Elon Musk replied on X to a post about a plan by Japan's SoftBank to raise as much as $100 billion from Gulf investors for a fund that would buy companies and run them better with AI. That plan was reported by the Financial Times, in a story our 9 Oct 2026 edition carried, which said SoftBank chief Masayoshi Son had held talks in recent weeks with Gulf investors; Stocktwits notes that SoftBank raised more than $11 billion in a high-yield bond sale last month at yields up to 9.75% and has committed billions to OpenAI, which Musk is suing.
notes: Yahoo Finance page carries a Stocktwits article; url is the Yahoo copy. Reply story: names the FT fundraising report. No investment advice.
